name: gamedev
description: revenantworks-gamedev — game-development skills on the -smith motif. Four members: pixelsmith, art direction for pixel art that must read at several zoom scales at once; godotsmith, Godot 4.x project conventions, the proof that a build is actually green, and asset intake; soundsmith, game audio direction judged by numbers; slicesmith, the test-first coding loop for game code. Standard-library scripts are allowed when declared.
